title: Font Manager curated pairings
description: Pairs of font families that go well together; the pairing model (data/pairings/model.json) learns from them. pairings.json follows it.

families.description: The two family names, as the fonts state them (name ID 16 or 1). Two different families; no pair twice in the file, in either order.

source.description: A short note on where the pairing comes from: the designers' own companion families, or an editor's pick and why.
